title: federation-types: required recipientUserId, optional ownerUserId
description: Part a of multi-mailbox federation (JMAP-ucha). crate-jmap-chat-federation-types src/peer.rs: add required pub recipient_user_id: String after account_id on PeerDeliverArgs, PeerReceiptArgs, PeerTypingArgs, PeerRetractArgs, PeerGroupUpdateArgs, PeerSubscribePresenceArgs, PeerUnsubscribePresenceArgs, PeerPresenceArgs; each constructor takes recipient_user_id as the 2nd parameter (after account_id). Field docs: account_id = the peer-role account (fed L404); subscriber_id/identity = identity of the user on the calling server. src/session.rs: FederationSession.owner_user_id -> Option<String>; new(peer_signing_keys) + with_owner_user_id(); from_session_extra accepts absent ownerUserId; anonymous_well_known_session inserts ownerUserId only when Some, and when None strips ownerUserId/ownerDirectAddress/ownerEndpoints (fed L396). Fix stale 'MUST include ownerUserId' docs. tests/draft_examples.rs: replace only_recipient(&args.extra) with extra.is_empty() + typed recipient_user_id asserts. peer-auth src/identity.rs and peer-auth-io keys.rs/lib.rs: docs only (ownerUserId is advisory owner metadata, applied only if bind_identity(owner, peer_domain) succeeds; never used for identity binding); add a bind_identity test alice@A.Example vs a.example (7.16) and a peer-auth-io test: Session without ownerUserId yields keys and owner_user_id None (7.18). BREAKING.
